sec-alert-bot: [ALERT] high-rate failed logins then successful session elevation detected for multiple accounts across EU/US regions (rule: auth_unusual_elevations). count=84 in 5m :rotating_light:
Alejandra: seeing this now, thanks. which identities are affected?
Sam: pulling auth logs, running quick SIEM query
Sam: ```siem query: index=auth events | where event.type in ("login","sso_assertion") | where geo not in user.home_geo and result=="success" | stats count by user, src_ip, user_agent```
Sam: top hits are svc-teamlead@company.com, isaac@company.com, and 3 service accounts that assume admin-role via SSO assertion
Maria: svc-teamlead? that one had MFA previously enabled. any MFA bypass evidence?
Kevin: checking MFA logs — we see a flow of many `push` prompts followed by `success` but from same src_ip cluster that previously failed. looks like MFA fatigue / automated accept pattern.
David: IPs show low TTL proxies, some known VPN exit nodes + 1 new ASN flagged. geo trail: NL -> DE -> US within 15m for same session token. impossible-travel vibe.
Alejandra: containment plan: 1) revoke active SSO sessions for impacted users/orgs, 2) block the src IPs at edge WAF, 3) disable service-account role assumption temporarily. agree?
Oncall-SRE: I'll run the session revoke API now: `POST /internal/admin/revoke_sessions {"users": ["svc-teamlead@company.com","isaac@company.com"], "reason":"suspected credential spray + elevation"}`
Oncall-SRE: revoke job queued, returns job_id=job-19901. will follow up. :white_check_mark:
Ops-bot: WAF rule updated to block 3 CIDR ranges (manual block).
Sam: also patching the RBAC policy to add a temporary deny on `role:admin` for any new SSO assertion until we finish triage. command: `rbacctl apply -f deny-sso-admin-temp.yaml`
Maria: we should rotate any short-lived signing keys used by the SSO provider and force new assertions. KMS rotation window?
Kevin: KMS note: the assertion signing key is in AWS KMS alias `alias/ssosign`. rotating will generate new public certs — IdP metadata update needed. I'll coordinate with IdP owner.
David: I exported audit traces for the affected time window and pushed to the SEC bucket: `s3://redwood-sec-audit/1990011222/` — includes raw SAML assertion IDs, truncated for PII.
Alejandra: good. Sam, prioritize users + service accounts list and escalate to SOC for user outreach and password resets where applicable. open a high-priority incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-789
Sam: done. ticket created. assigned to SOC and IAM.
Oncall-SRE: all active sessions for affected users revoked. Ops confirmed WAF blocks. RBAC patch applied (temporary).
Sec-alert-bot: follow-up detection rule suppressed for the next 10m to avoid alert storm (auto-suppress by rule id).
Maria: next steps: 1) force password resets for humans flagged, 2) rotate service account keys, 3) rotate KMS alias `alias/ssosign` after IdP change window, 4) increase auth audit retention to 365d subset for SSO assertion logs.
Kevin: I'll schedule KMS rotate after IdP test window — ETA 2h. Will post breakpoint times.
David: recommend new long-term mitigations: one-time token rate-limiter on SSO assertion endpoints, adaptive MFA (high-risk require additional verification), and automated anomaly playbook to revoke role assumption if geo-hops detected.
Alejandra: agreed. also postmortem owner? I'd like security + IAM + infra leads. assign to Maria, Kevin, and Sam. target 72h initial blameless postmortem.
Sam: capturing lessons and timeline in the ticket. I'll add the SIEM queries and commands used.
Ops-bot: Notifying legal and compliance per data-access policy.
Maria: quick ask for logs: export of KMS usage during the window, and IdP assertion metadata. Kevin can you pull and attach to SEC-789?
Kevin: on it. attaching KMS CloudTrail snippet: ```cloudtrail filter: EventName=Encrypt OR EventName=GenerateDataKey OR EventName=RotateKey | where eventTime between 2026-03-19T09:10:00Z and 2026-03-19T09:20:00Z```
David: final note: no evidence yet of data exfiltration, only session elevation. we'll keep investigating.
Alejandra: thanks team. keep updates in the ticket thread, and update the status channel when we have KMS rotate scheduled. closing Slack thread for comms consolidation.
